title: 부엌에서 요리하기: 씻고, 썰고, 볶고, 끓여요
objective: By the end, you can choose the right cooking verb (씻다, 썰다, 넣다, 볶다, 끓이다, 굽다) for a food and use it with 냄비, 프라이팬, and 소금 in short sentences.
summary: Learn ten everyday kitchen words in Korean, including basic cooking verbs and cookware, and use them in short real-life sentences.

task.title: Use cooking words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, or order the Korean words you learned on page 1.

words.exampleMeaning: I cook at home on weekends.
Wash the vegetables in water first.

words.meaning: to slice, to cut up (with a knife)

words.exampleMeaning: I put an egg in the ramyeon.
If you stir-fry kimchi and rice together, you get kimchi fried rice.

words.meaning: to boil; to make (a soup or stew) by boiling
words.exampleMeaning: Mom made doenjang stew this morning.

words.meaning: to grill, to roast, to bake
words.exampleMeaning: Shall we grill some meat for dinner tonight?
The frying pan is still hot.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 차를 마시고 싶어요. 물을 (볶을까요 / 끓일까요)? ② 생선을 프라이팬에 (구웠어요 / 썰었어요). ③ 감자를 작게 (썰어요 / 넣어요).
Fill in the blank with 냄비, 프라이팬, or 소금: ① 소시지를 ____에 구워요. ② 찌개가 너무 짜요. ____을 너무 많이 넣었어요. ③ 라면은 작은 ____에 끓여요.
Put the steps in order to make ramyeon: (가) 면과 수프를 넣어요. (나) 냄비에 물을 넣어요. (다) 물을 끓여요. (라) 마지막에 파를 썰어서 넣어요.
Write the verb in the -아요/어요 form (hint: 굽다 becomes 구워-): ① 저는 아침마다 토스트를 ____. (굽다) ② 동생이 양파를 ____. (썰다) ③ 아빠가 고기와 채소를 ____. (볶다)
Fill in the blank with one word from page 1 (put verbs in the -아요/어요 or -(으)세요 form): ① 당근이 더러워요. 먼저 물에 ____. ② 국이 맛이 없어요. 소금을 조금 더 ____. ③ 제 취미는 ____예요. 주말마다 친구들에게 음식을 만들어 줘요.
answers: ① 끓일까요 ② 구웠어요 ③ 썰어요
① 프라이팬 ② 소금 ③ 냄비
① 구워요 ② 썰어요 ③ 볶아요
① 씻어요 (씻으세요) ② 넣어요 (넣으세요) ③ 요리
